description: Minutes approval workflow: submit, approve (issue), return, correct.
precondition: Minutes in the needed status; approver and secretary actors.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Chair.
Revision WaitingApproval with UpdatedAt T; the caller read it at T.
Meeting participants and organizer accounts are active.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the waiting revision; actor: the current Chair; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Status Issued with ApprovedBy = the Chair and ApprovedAt = IssuedAt = now; 200 MSG427.
cases.log: Saved: status, approver and issue times; audit row for the issue (actor = the Chair, details carry meeting, revision and replaced-revision ids); notification "Biên bản đã ban hành" to every reader except the Chair ("Biên bản cuộc họp "…" đã được ban hành."); issue emails queued for the same readers.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Chair.
WaitingApproval correction whose SupersedesId points at revision 1 (Issued); the caller read it at T.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the waiting correction; actor: the current Chair; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Status Issued; revision 1 becomes Superseded and stays readable; 200 MSG427 with the correction message.
cases.log: Saved: the correction Issued, the earlier revision Superseded; audit row; notifications and emails carry "Bản đính chính biên bản cuộc họp "…" đã được ban hành."

cases.inputs: minutesId: the waiting revision; actor: the stranger; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 with no message code; status unchanged and nobody notified.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the waiting revision; actor: the current Secretary; loadedAt: T.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the current Chair; loadedAt: T.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Chair.
WaitingApproval revision read at T, then saved by someone else.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the waiting revision; actor: the current Chair; loadedAt: T.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Chair; WaitingApproval revision read at T.
The database fails while saving the transition.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the waiting revision; actor: the current Chair; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG404; status unchanged and nobody notified.
cases.log: Error logged with the action and minutes id.
